newsitem.title: USA: A.T. Cross encouraged by foreign growth.
newsitem.headline: A.T. Cross encouraged by foreign growth.

text.p: A.T. Cross Co said on Thursday its domestic market results were constrained by low consumer awareness of new product lines, but the Canadian market rebounded and the company is encouraged by continuing growth in foreign markets.
The company reported first-quarter net income of $0.05 per share, down from $0.10 for the same period the year before.
The domestic retail market continued to be restrained by consumer-awareness problems, but that was partially offset by the performance of the Special Markets division, the company said.
Growth in Europe and Latin America were part of an encouraging foreign-markets trend, although foreign exchange problems had a negative impact, the company said.
A.T. Cross also mentioned a "resurgence" in Canada for the first quarter.
The company makes writing instruments and distributes leather products and other gift items.
